articles.title: Two New Sea Spider Species Discovered in the Salish Sea — First in Nearly a Century
articles.summary: Researchers found two new sea spider species in the Salish Sea — the first described there in almost 100 years. One has hairy legs, red eyes, and a mouth like a tiny Sarlacc pit.

articles.title: Dead Star Produces a Shock Wave That Defies Explanation
articles.summary: Astronomers spotted a huge bow shock around a dead star called RXJ0528+2838 — but the star has no disc, so it shouldn't be able to make one. The finding challenges current ideas.

articles.title: Gene Therapy Restores Memory in Mice by Reprogramming Brain Cells
articles.summary: Scientists in Switzerland used a gene therapy cocktail to make memory-storing neurons in mice act young again. The memories weren't gone — the brain's "hardware" was just too old to access them.
